items.title: Morocco’s PAM party leads the election results
items.why: Provisional results gave the party 97 of 395 seats, so no party won a majority. Turnout was about 38%.

items.title: Shin Ohashi, 17, sets a 200m breaststroke world record
items.why: His 2:04.83 at the Asian Games makes the Japanese swimmer the first man under 2:05.

items.title: The US Federal Reserve raises interest rates
items.why: A unanimous 0.25-point rise to 3.75–4%, its first increase since July 2023. Borrowing gets more expensive.

items.title: A brand-new crater is found on the Moon
items.why: About 222 m wide, it formed in 2024 and was spotted in NASA orbiter images. Impacts this big happen roughly once every 132 years.

items.title: August ties the record for Earth’s hottest month
items.why: Copernicus measured 16.96°C, level with July 2023 and 1.65°C above pre-industrial levels.
